description: This file provides a set of functions for interacting with a backend API, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) for work items and comments, as well as utility functions for constructing URLs and handling authorization headers.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds headers with Authorization if token is available.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request and returns parsed JSON or throws on error.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body and returns parsed JSON or throws on error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters and returns parsed JSON or throws on error.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body and returns parsed JSON or throws on error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug).

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds and returns the full URL for a given API path.

ctags.name: addWorkItemComment
ctags.pattern: /^export async function addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null }) {$/

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.name: updateWorkItemStatus
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
